instruction: Design a system that combines a priority encoder with a barrel shifter. The priority encoder should implement a 4-to-2 priority encoder with four inputs (A, B, C, and D) and two outputs (Y1 and Y0) according to the priority order (D > C > B > A). The barrel shifter should take in a 4-bit data input and a 2-bit shift input and shift the data input by the number of positions determined by the shift input. The system should include an additional functional module that takes in the outputs of the priority encoder (Y1 and Y0) and performs a bitwise OR operation with the shifted data input. The final output should be the result of the OR operation.
